evidence_summary: Panobinostat treatment in patients confirmed HDAC inhibition via increased histone acetylation in blood, fat pad, and tumor biopsies, validating target engagement.
validation_methods: Pharmacodynamic histone acetylation measurement in blood
Fat pad biopsy histone acetylation analysis
disease: Non-small cell lung cancer and head and neck cancer

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Panobinostat treatment led to increased histone acetylation in blood, fat pad biopsies, and tumor samples from patients, confirming HDAC inhibition in vivo.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: patient blood, fat pad biopsies, tumor biopsies

title: A phase I, pharmacokinetic, and pharmacodynamic study of panobinostat, an HDAC inhibitor, combined with erlotinib in patients with advanced aerodigestive tract tumors.
journal: Clinical cancer research : an official journal of the American Association for Cancer Research

evidence_summary: Swainsonine treatment in a phase I trial inhibited Golgi alpha-mannosidase II in patient peripheral blood lymphocytes, as shown by decreased leukoagglutinin binding, confirming target engagement.
disease: advanced malignancies

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Decreased leukoagglutinin binding to peripheral blood lymphocytes after 5 days of swainsonine infusion indicated inhibition of Golgi alpha-mannosidase II; urine oligomannosides increased 5-10 fold.

title: A phase I study of swainsonine in patients with advanced malignancies.

evidence_summary: Rap1GAP overexpression in SCC cells increased invasion and MMP2/9 secretion; chemical and RNAi blockade of MMP2/9 inhibited invasion; IHC on tissue microarray confirmed correlation of Rap1GAP with MMP9 and poor survival with high MMP9.
disease: Head and neck squamous cell carcinoma

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Overexpression in SCC cells increased invasion and MMP2/9 secretion; IHC on tissue microarray showed correlation with MMP9 expression.
Rap1GAP up-regulated MMP9 transcription and secretion; RNAi blockade of MMP9 inhibited invasion; high MMP9 IHC staining prognostic of poor survival.
Rap1GAP up-regulated MMP2 transcription; RNAi blockade of MMP2 inhibited invasion; MMP2 intensity correlated with T stage.

title: Rap1GAP promotes invasion via induction of matrix metalloproteinase 9 secretion, which is associated with poor survival in low N-stage squamous cell carcinoma.

disease: head and neck squamous cell carcinoma, colorectal cancer
title: A noninvasive approach for assessing tumor hypoxia in xenografts: developing a urinary marker for hypoxia.

evidence_summary: Recombinant IL-1alpha treatment and IL-1alpha gene overexpression in UM-SCC cell lines increased IL-8 and GM-CSF secretion, which was blocked by IL-1 receptor antagonist or anti-IL-1 neutralizing antibody.
disease: head and neck squamous cell carcinoma

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Recombinant IL-1alpha or IL-1alpha gene overexpression induced IL-8 and GM-CSF production in UM-SCC cell lines; IL-1 receptor antagonist or neutralizing antibody inhibited this induction.
IL-8 production increased upon recombinant IL-1alpha treatment or IL-1alpha overexpression, and was inhibited by IL-1RA or neutralizing antibody.
GM-CSF production increased upon recombinant IL-1alpha treatment or IL-1alpha overexpression, and was inhibited by IL-1RA or neutralizing antibody.

title: Effects of interleukin-1alpha, interleukin-1 receptor antagonist, and neutralizing antibody on proinflammatory cytokine expression by human squamous cell carcinoma lines.

evidence_summary: Deguelin bound to the ATP-binding pocket of Hsp90, disrupted its chaperone function, and promoted ubiquitin-mediated degradation of client proteins HIF-1α and Akt; xenograft models (H1299, A549, UMSCC38, MKN45, PC-3) confirmed tumor growth inhibition, and adenoviral overexpression of Hsp90 was used to assess functional rescue.
disease: Non-small-cell lung cancer

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Deguelin bound to the ATP-binding pocket of Hsp90, suppressed its chaperone function, and induced ubiquitin-mediated proteasomal degradation of client proteins; adenoviral overexpression of Hsp90 was used to confirm the target role.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: H1299, A549, UMSCC38, MKN45, PC-3 cell lines; xenograft mice

title: Structural basis for depletion of heat shock protein 90 client proteins by deguelin.
journal: Journal of the National Cancer Institute

evidence_summary: PERK inhibitor HC4 treatment in mouse syngeneic and PDX models eliminated dormant/ISRhigh disseminated cancer cells and blocked metastasis; HC4 also killed dormant DCCs in HNSCC and HER2+ cancers, and CDK4/6 inhibitor combination reduced metastatic burden, supported by single-cell profiling and imaging.
disease: Metastatic breast cancer and head and neck squamous cell carcinoma

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Treatment with PERK inhibitor HC4 killed quiescent/slow-cycling ISRhigh disseminated cancer cells in mouse models, blocked metastasis, and reduced metastatic burden when combined with CDK4/6 inhibitors; HC4 also killed dormant DCCs in HNSCC and HER2+ cancers, with killing in HER2+ tumors mediated by reduced HER2 activity.

title: A PERK-Specific Inhibitor Blocks Metastatic Progression by Limiting Integrated Stress Response-Dependent Survival of Quiescent Cancer Cells.
journal: Clinical cancer research : an official journal of the American Association for Cancer Research

evidence_summary: Cinobufotalin treatment in NPC cell lines and in vivo xenografts potentiated FOXO1-mediated cisplatin sensitivity by downregulating MYH9, modulating GSK3β/β-catenin pathway and stemness/EMT signals.
disease: nasopharyngeal carcinoma

validated_targets.experimental_detail: FOXO1 overexpression induced miR-200b and sensitized NPC cells to cisplatin; low FOXO1 and high MYH9 correlated with worst survival in clinical samples.
Cinobufotalin downregulated MYH9, disrupting its interaction with GSK3β and TRAF6, thereby increasing GSK3β stability and reversing stemness/EMT; high MYH9 indicated poor prognosis.
FOXO1 induced miR-200b expression through GSK3β/β-catenin/TCF4/ZEB1 network, leading to reduced tumor stemness and EMT.
FOXO1 suppressed MYH9 expression by modulating the PI3K/AKT/c-Myc/P53/miR-133a-3p signaling cascade.
MYH9 downregulation reduced TRAF6-mediated ubiquitination of GSK3β, leading to increased GSK3β and subsequent stimulation of β-catenin/TCF4/ZEB1/miR-200b network.

title: Chemical compound cinobufotalin potently induces FOXO1-stimulated cisplatin sensitivity by antagonizing its binding partner MYH9.

evidence_summary: Galectin-1 manipulation in head and neck cancer and lung cancer mouse models revealed that Gal1 enhances STING protein stability, sustaining NF-κB signaling and CXCL2 expression, which promotes PMN-MDSC recruitment and metastasis.
disease: Head and Neck Cancer

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Tumoral Galectin-1 promoted the establishment of a premetastatic niche through PMN-MDSC recruitment, and sustained NF-κB activation by enhancing STING protein stability.
Galectin-1 increased STING protein stability in cancer cells, leading to chronic STING activation and protumoral metastasis promotion.
Gal1-NF-κB signaling triggered enhanced CXCL2 expression, mediating MDSC migration to the premetastatic niche.
Gal1 sustained NF-κB activation via STING stabilization, which promoted CXCL2 expression and MDSC trafficking.

title: Galectin-1 Mediates Chronic STING Activation in Tumors to Promote Metastasis through MDSC Recruitment.
